text_block_list.text:
Empires weren't built in a day! Now, it's
time for
my daily practice!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ahh, ahh. Good, my throat seems fine
today.
Excellent.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The treble is quite weak. It's not

conveying my first-rate majesty at all.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
No, that's subpar... A true first-rate
laugh
demands MORE!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That day, Кинг Хало arrives at the
practice field
looking exhausted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
